feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Dubai wholesaler plans renewed bid for collapsed Poundland
articles.summary: The Dubai-based businessman who emerged as a suitor for Poundland days before its collapse into insolvency is planning a fresh bid to buy the retailer out of administration.

articles.title: UK writes to veterans to ready them for possibility of mobilisation
articles.summary: The UK has written to around 100,000 former military personnel to ready them for the possibility of mobilisation in the event of war.

articles.title: 'Biggest shake-up of stalking laws in over a decade' unveiled
articles.summary: A new standalone stalking offence is to be introduced as part of what the government is calling the "biggest shake-up of stalking laws in over a decade".

articles.title: UK net migration falls to lowest level in three decades, excluding pandemic
articles.summary: UK net migration fell to 77,000 in the year to June 2026, provisional new data from the Office for National Statistics (ONS) shows.

articles.title: Child homelessness increases chance of being NEET, study says
articles.summary: Young people born around the time of the millennium who were homeless as a child are twice as likely as their peers to be a NEET, research suggests.

articles.title: Britain's weather could be about to feel very different, Met Office warns
articles.summary: The UK can expect fewer winter frosts and more days of hot weather as a result of climate change, according to the Met Office.

articles.title: Surgeon whose cases are being reviewed over 'patient harm' leaves hospital
articles.summary: A suspended surgeon whose cases are being reviewed for potentially causing harm to patients is no longer working for her hospital trust.

articles.title: Simon Le Bon pays tribute to Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor
articles.summary: Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor has died at the age of 65.

articles.title: Think you know the facts about immigration? Take our quiz
articles.summary: The debate around immigration is a complicated one, and often confused by conflicting information from different sides of the argument.
